headline: ERS promotes virtual school on clinical management of respiratory infections
dek: The European Respiratory Society said the online school will take place next month and will include plenary discussions, case presentations with live voting and a multidisciplinary panel.
body:
The European Respiratory Society (ERS) has promoted a virtual school on the clinical management of respiratory infections, which it said will take place next month.

In a post on X on 6 November 2026, the society urged followers not to miss the online event. According to the post, participants will take part in plenary discussions, case presentations with live voting, and a multidisciplinary panel discussion.

The text of the post did not give further details, such as exact dates, the programme or speakers. It directed readers to a link for more information.

The ERS describes itself on X as dedicated to sharing scientific knowledge, fighting lung disease and promoting lung health.
